# Network Agent

> AI-powered network scanner with LLM integration. Combines nmap, impacket, scapy and other tools with natural language for security assessments.

## Quick Start
- [README.md](README.md): Installation, Usage, Docker, CLI Examples
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Version History
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to Contribute

## Core (Agent Logic)
- [cli.py](cli.py): Entry Point, REPL-Mode, `--serve` for HTTP API
- [agent/core.py](agent/core.py): NetworkAgent class, Session Memory, Tool-Execution, Authorization Enforcement
- [agent/llm.py](agent/llm.py): LLM Client (OpenAI-compatible, Groq, Ollama)

## Tools (Attack-Chain Architecture)
- [tools/base.py](tools/base.py): BaseTool ABC with authorization_level, category, target_fields, report_finding()
- [tools/authorization.py](tools/authorization.py): 3-Tier Authorization (passive/active/destructive)
- [tools/scope.py](tools/scope.py): Scope Enforcement (--scope-file CIDR/host allowlist)
- [tools/findings_store.py](tools/findings_store.py): SQLite Findings Database (WAL, thread-safe, credential redaction)
- [tools/findings_export.py](tools/findings_export.py): Export to JSON, CSV, HTML with SHA256 integrity

### Recon (passive)
- [tools/recon/ping_sweep.py](tools/recon/ping_sweep.py): Host-Discovery via nmap
- [tools/recon/port_scanner.py](tools/recon/port_scanner.py): Port-Scanning
- [tools/recon/service_detect.py](tools/recon/service_detect.py): Service/Version Detection
- [tools/recon/dns_lookup.py](tools/recon/dns_lookup.py): DNS Queries

### Other Attack Phases (v0.13+)
- [tools/poison/](tools/poison/): LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning, ARP Spoofing
- [tools/enum/](tools/enum/): LDAP, SMB, SNMP, ADCS, GPO Enumeration
- [tools/harvest/](tools/harvest/): Kerberoasting, SMB Relay, Password Spray
- [tools/lateral/](tools/lateral/): Pass-the-Hash, WMI Exec, WinRM Exec
- [tools/persist/](tools/persist/): Golden Ticket, ADCS Persistence
- [tools/compliance/](tools/compliance/): Reports, Attack Chain Summary

### OSINT
- [tools/web/web_search.py](tools/web/web_search.py): SearXNG Web Search

## Configuration
- [config/settings.yaml](config/settings.yaml): LLM-Provider, Authorization, Findings, Tool-Settings
- [config/prompts/system.md](config/prompts/system.md): System Prompt Template

## HTTP API
- [agent/api/](agent/api/): FastAPI Server (`python cli.py --serve`)
- [agent/api/routers/findings.py](agent/api/routers/findings.py): GET /api/v1/findings, /scan-runs, /export
